description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'MapContextTest' for testing the behavior of 'MapContext' and related classes within the 'org.apache.ofbiz.base.util.collections' package. It includes an inner static class 'PNode' simulating a node with properties and included child nodes, and a test method 'controllerConfigLikeContext' that verifies order preservation when composing properties from nested nodes.

classes.name: MapContextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of MapContext and nested configurations within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PNode
classes.description: A simplified node class representing configuration nodes with properties and included sub-nodes, used to test property aggregation and order preservation.

methods.name: controllerConfigLikeContext
methods.description: A JUnit test method that creates nested 'PNode' instances with ordered properties and asserts that the order is preserved when properties are combined into a 'MapContext'.
